format: RGBA PNG for character and creature atlases; RGB/RGBA PNG for scenery
art_direction: Simplified hand-painted Chinese dark-folklore, ink outlines, broad graphic shadow planes, warm parchment, charcoal and faded oxblood. Adult proportions; no photorealism or pixel art.

prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is an exact 4-column by 3-row technical body-part layout for a functioning 2D cutout character. Image 2 is the approved ART STYLE AND CHARACTER reference. Redraw every isolated component in Image 1 into Image 2's simplified hand-painted Chinese dark-folklore style: bold ink contours, large graphic warm charcoal shadow planes, 3 or 4 values per material, economical dry-brush accents, warm tan skin, worn charcoal clothing and muted oxblood sash. Face should match the angular stubbled man in image 2. Keep the EXACT canvas aspect ratio, 4x3 cell arrangement, disconnected body parts, camera orientations, overall object silhouettes, joint ends, centers, sizes and generous transparent gutters from Image 1. This is a usable rig atlas, NOT a character illustration. Do not assemble a person. Make the torso a short wrap-collar tunic with a small ragged bone-gray shoulder cloth contained inside its silhouette; no bulky cape or detached accessories. Upper arm sleeve and forearm bracer as in reference, dark fitted trousers, calf wrap in faded bone color rather than red, modest brown boot. Simplify the separate hair tail into a broad ink-brush graphic. Steel dao with simple dark grip and aged bronze guard, no ornate dragon. Row1: right-facing head, separate hair tail, torso, pelvis. Row2: downward upper arm, downward forearm without hand, closed gripping fist, relaxed far hand. Row3: downward thigh, calf-and-boot complete piece, horizontal curved dao, isolated boot. Preserve these EXACT roles and orientations in all twelve cells. No photorealism, no 3D, no tiny cloth texture, no additional objects, no text or guides. Genuine clean transparent RGBA background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the LEATHER ARMOR equipment variant of this exact hand-painted 2D cutout character atlas. Keep the exact image dimensions, transparent background, 4 columns by 3 rows grid, all twelve objects at EXACTLY the same positions, sizes, orientation, silhouettes and joint attachment shapes. Keep the head, hair, skin, closed fist, open hand and dao identical. Change clothing only: torso becomes chestnut-brown boiled leather vest with large ink-edged panels, simple dark lacing, bone-gray collar shoulder scrap, same faded red sash; upper arm gets small leather shoulder reinforcement over same rolled sleeve, forearm gets clearly visible brown leather bracer, pelvis and thigh have brown leather side guards over charcoal trousers, calf and boots get brown leather guards with muted red straps. Visibly different from the cloth set, restrained simplified woodcut/hand-painted style with broad planar shading and black outlines. No intricate buckles or texture noise. Do not draw full characters or alter anatomy. Genuine transparent alpha; no labels, no background, no shadows outside parts.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the IRON CHAIN ARMOR variant of this exact hand-painted 2D character atlas. Preserve exact dimensions, transparent alpha background, 4 columns x 3 rows grid, component positions, sizes, overall silhouettes, orientation, joint endpoints. Do not assemble figures. Keep the head, hair, bare skin, hands and curved dao absolutely unchanged. Only clothing changes: torso wears dark blue-gray iron lamellar chest panels over charcoal undercloth, large simple overlapping iron plates and a short readable band of chain rings, aged bronze edges and muted oxblood sash; upper arm has a compact dark iron shoulder guard; forearm has a dark metal bracer; pelvis and thigh have iron skirt panels over charcoal trousers; calf and boot get iron shin plates with two dark straps. This must be clearly distinct from cloth and brown leather. Matte desaturated blue-gray iron with two or three graphic shadow values, bold dark ink edge, simplified hand-painted Chinese folklore/woodcut aesthetic. No photorealistic metals, tiny dense patterns, shiny gold or extra ornaments. All 12 cells retain their exact isolated object roles. No text. Clean genuine transparent RGBA.

Use case: stylized-concept. Make a wide landscape background painting for the actual playable side-scrolling Chinese dark folklore game matching the supplied character sheet's simplified hand-painted ink and woodcut art style. Background ONLY, no characters, no monsters, no UI, no text. Composition is an old mountain-village shrine road in drought: a worn small tiled shrine and leaning village roofs at the far left and far right, leafless persimmon tree on left, a weathered wooden gate and two faded red prayer strips on the right, distant layered misty Chinese mountains and a tiny mountain temple on the skyline. Clear side-on flat walking ground, broad open path along exactly 78 percent image height; keep the middle 60 percent horizontally open for characters to fight. Bottom 22 percent is gently textured stone and packed earth foreground, no giant props blocking feet. Upper area mostly warm parchment sky and pale mist, no sun disk. Warm bone paper, restrained sepia, charcoal ink, a few faded oxblood accents. Strong graphic silhouettes for nearby roof edges, three broad value groups for mountains, large brush shapes, modest dry-brush paper texture. Readable 2D game stage with horizontal lateral view, not an overhead aerial view and not a receding road into the distance. Mood: old illustrated Chinese folklore scroll, subdued but not dark or photorealistic. Wide panoramic composition, fill entire canvas.

Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is a production monster animation atlas, 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 isolated poses. Image 2 is the approved simplified hand-painted ink/woodcut game style. Redraw the SAME root-and-vine forest spirit creature from image 1 in image 2's visual language: bold black-brown ink outlines, broad graphic shadow planes, three to four values, warm weathered gray-brown wood with subtle desaturated moss green and small bone details. Keep all 12 frames, original canvas aspect, exact grid, frame centers, footprints, facing RIGHT, gesture progression, body silhouette and contact baseline. First row four walking poses; second row windup, long reaching strike, recovery, idle; third row four progressive collapsing/death poses. The same creature identity and proportions in every frame. Increase readable stylized detail from original pixel art but no photorealism, no 3D, no tiny pixel squares or dense tangled-line noise. Large branch hands, crouched humanoid trunk body and root feet. No gore. All poses entirely inside their own cells, wide clean transparent gutters, no text, no grid lines. Genuine transparent RGBA background.
